name: frame_timing_mutex_lock

name: frame_timing_mutex_unlock
notes: Releases the middleware mutex with the lock's convention. Null pointer returns 0 without calling the kernel; a zero kernel result reports 0; any nonzero result is replaced by the fixed 0x21.

name: frame_timing_semaphore_delete

name: frame_timing_semaphore_wait
notes: Wrapper over sceKernelWaitSema asking for one unit. No handle test. Zero stays zero; any nonzero result becomes the fixed 0x21, not the kernel error.

name: frame_timing_semaphore_signal
notes: Wrapper over sceKernelSignalSema posting one unit. No handle test. Zero stays zero; any nonzero result becomes the fixed 0x21, not the kernel error.
